mulatika-en.title: Vibhaṅga-mūlaṭīkā in English (draft)
mulatika-en.author: Ānanda
mulatika-en.edition: Draft translation from the Sixth Council text, 2026
mulatika-en.by: Vibhaṅga-mūlaṭīkā, by Ānanda Vanaratana · the text of the Sixth Buddhist Council (Chaṭṭha Saṅgāyana), Yangon · digital edition of the Vipassana Research Institute
mulatika-en.blurb: A draft English translation of the Mūlaṭīkā, made with Claude for this library from the Sixth Council Pāli, paragraph by paragraph, to be read beside the Pāli and checked.
mulatika-en.note: The Mūlaṭīkā in English, part by part, with the same paragraphs, § numbers and page anchors as the Pāli, so that the two can be read side by side. A draft, made with Claude: the Pāli is the authority. Translated so far: none yet.
mulatika-en.toc_foot: The eighteen vibhaṅgas ({{NPARA}} numbered paragraphs, by the paragraph of the Vibhaṅga).
mulatika-en.source: Translated with Claude from the Chaṭṭha Saṅgāyana text of the Mūlaṭīkā (VRI digital edition) for this library. A draft: the conventions and the term list are in data/translations/README.md.
mulatika-en.desc: A draft English translation of the Mūlaṭīkā, beside its Pāli.
howto: Type in Search (or press /). Accents are optional: rupa finds rūpa.
Type the number of the Vibhaṅga paragraph in § (1–1044); only some paragraphs have a sub-comment.
The chips beside a § open the same paragraph in the Sammohavinodanī, the Pāli text and the Anuṭīkā.
mulatika-en.goto_aria: Go to the commentary on a paragraph
mulatika-en.drawer_hint: The text has no index of its own.
